text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking for Vodka,
I head up to the rooftop and find—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Getting fan letters really isn't
my style, but it still makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...?
What's this, a portrait of me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, even I get fan letters once in a while, you know...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And so, when I opened it,
there was a portrait of me inside the envelope.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haha, and the funny thing is, it looks nothing like 'em.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I look way cooler than this
when I'm actually running.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Some little kid probably worked really hard
to draw this for me."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Something like this touches my heart way more than any long fan letter ever could."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna disappoint my little fans, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna win the next race by a mile
and show everyone an even cooler side of me!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Come on!
I'll leave you behind if you keep spacing out, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems a fan letter from a young fan has ignited a fire in Vodka's heart.
